head: SOLUTIONS
title: Our Solutions
description: Scientifically Supported Probiotic Solutions for Sustainable Production.

solutions.name: POULTRY SOLUTIONS
solutions.head: Disease Resistance & Viral Defense
solutions.challenge: High mortality rates due to pathogens and viral threats like Bird Flu.

descriptions.head: Drastic Mortality Reduction:
descriptions.description: Proven to reduce mortality from 50% down to 10% in birds challenged with VVNDV and ochratoxins.

descriptions.head: Pathogen Control:
descriptions.description: Naturally replaces harmful bacteria such as Salmonella, E. coli, and Clostridia by promoting the growth of beneficial Lactobacilli and Bifidobacteria.

descriptions.head: Viral Protection:
descriptions.description: Creates a hostile environment in the gut that inhibits the replication of harmful viruses, specifically the H5N1 influenza virus (Bird Flu).

descriptions.head: Performance:
descriptions.description: Improves weight loss issues caused by toxins and enhances the transformational efficiency of feed.

solutions.name: LIVESTOCK SOLUTIONS
solutions.head: Growth & Dairy Excellence
solutions.challenge: Improving weight gain and maintaining milk quality in cattle, sheep, and camels.

descriptions.head: Superior Weight Gain:
descriptions.description: Achieves a 15-25% increase in growth over normal rates. Studies show a 170% weight gain compared to 130% in control groups over six months.

descriptions.head: Dairy Optimization:
descriptions.description: Eliminates acidity in milk and increases total milk production for animals on concentrated rations.

descriptions.head: Digestive Health:
descriptions.description: Acts as a natural appetite stimulant, prevents bloating and gluttony, and effectively treats fungal toxins in the digestive system.

solutions.name: AQUACULTURE SOLUTIONS
solutions.head: Water Quality & Metabolism
solutions.challenge: High ammonia levels and low oxygen resistance in fish farming.

descriptions.head: Environmental Management:
descriptions.description: Specifically designed to decrease ammonia rates and reduce water pollution, leading to a healthier aquatic environment.

descriptions.head: Metabolic Boost:
descriptions.description: Improves fish metabolism and increases overall body weight.

descriptions.head: Vitality & Resilience:
descriptions.description: Increases red blood cell counts and hemoglobin levels to help fish resist low-oxygen environments.

descriptions.head: Disease Prevention:
descriptions.description: Protects against bacterial diseases affecting the skin, respiratory, and digestive systems.

solutions.name: RABBIT SOLUTIONS
solutions.head: Stress & Productivity Management
solutions.challenge: High sensitivity to heat and labor-related stress.

descriptions.head: Anti-Stress Protection:
descriptions.description: Increases resistance to severe stress resulting from high temperatures, labor, lactation, or sudden changes in feeding.

descriptions.head: Immune Support:
descriptions.description: Raises the production of immune bodies and red blood cells to prevent GI diseases like diarrhea and impaction.

descriptions.head: Growth & Quality:
descriptions.description: Promotes rapid growth and significantly improves the tenderness and taste of the meat.

items.title: 100% Natural
items.description: No chemicals, antibiotics, or hormones used in any of our solutions.

items.title: Pharmaceutical Quality
items.description: Every solution is developed using European technology and supervised under strict GMP standards for maximum consistency.

items.title: Proven Results
items.description: Backed by over 20 years of field experience and academic studies in the Middle East.
